 Madura United vs Persib Bandung Schedule October 22, 2026: Score Prediction and Live Broadcast
 The Madura United vs Persib Bandung match will be one of the highlights of the sixth week of the 2026/2027 BRI Super League. Both teams are scheduled to meet at the Gelora Madura Ratu Pamelingan Stadium, Pamekasan, East Java, on Thursday (10/22/2026) evening.
 By: Damar Prasetya 
 | 
 Editor: Nayla Savitri 
 | 
 Contributor: Keisya Anjani 
 October 22, 2026, 12:15 WITA · 5 min read 
 Persib Bandung players try to control the ball while being guarded by Madura United players in a Super League match at Gelora Bandung Lautan Api Stadium, February 26, 2026. Both teams are scheduled to meet again on Thursday (10/22/2026) in Pamekasan. Source: match archive photo. 
 PAMEKASAN, Aktualita.co - The Madura United vs Persib Bandung match will be one of the highlights of the sixth week of the 2026/2027 BRI Super League. Both teams are scheduled to meet at the Gelora Madura Ratu Pamelingan Stadium, Pamekasan, East Java, on Thursday (10/22/2026) evening. 
 The duel, which kicks off at 19:00 WIB, is expected to be intense. Madura United is looking to maintain its unbeaten home record, while Persib arrives with the ambition to continue their positive trend and improve their position in the provisional standings. 
 Advertisement 
 The competition is heating up as both teams have collected 10 points from five matches. The result of this meeting has the potential to change the landscape of the top-tier standings. 
 Madura United vs Persib Bandung Schedule Today 
 Based on the official ILeague schedule, the match between Madura United and Persib Bandung will take place with the following details: 
 Match: Madura United vs Persib Bandung 
 Competition: BRI Super League 2026/2027 
 Week: Sixth 
 Day/Date: Thursday, October 22, 2026 
 Kick-off: 19:00 WIB or 20:00 WITA 
 Stadium: Gelora Madura Ratu Pamelingan, Pamekasan 
 Live broadcast : Indosiar 
 Live streaming: Vidio 
 This match is an important opportunity for both teams to secure three points before the competition enters the next series of matches. 
 Madura United Determined to Maintain Home Record 
 Madura United has promising momentum when hosting Persib. From their previous three home matches, Laskar Sape Kerrab recorded two wins and one draw. 
 They defeated Persijap Jepara 2-0, beat PSIM Yogyakarta 2-1, and drew 3-3 against Bhayangkara Presisi Lampung FC. 
 However, Madura United's performance has not been entirely stable lately. After starting the season with three consecutive wins, the team from the Salt Island lost 0-2 to Persik Kediri on October 9 before being held to a draw by Bhayangkara on October 16. 
 Madura United coach, Jose Gomes, stated that the players' physical condition is good enough to face the defending champions. 
 "The important thing is that we cannot fail to get points," said Jose Gomes in his statement ahead of the match. Madura United is expected to rely on an aggressive game in front of their own supporters. The presence of Lulinha and Gali Freitas can provide attacking variety, while Dimitar Mitkov is one of the players to watch after scoring four goals early in the season. 
 Madura United captain, Lulinha, also emphasized the importance of maintaining positive results in Pamekasan. 
 "Keeping that record intact is the key," he asserted. Persib Bandung Arrives with Winning Momentum 
 In the visiting camp, Persib Bandung brings confidence after securing a narrow 1-0 victory over Persik Kediri on Sunday (10/18/2026). 
 Julio Cesar's goal in the 79th minute ensured Maung Bandung secured three points at the Si Jalak Harupat Stadium. 
 The result continues the positive trend for Igor Tolic's team, who also previously won in an Asian inter-club match. 
 However, Persib is facing fitness issues due to a tight competition schedule. Within 14 days, Marc Klok and his teammates have had to play five matches in various competitions. 
 This situation makes player rotation one of the coach's considerations. 
 Tolic acknowledged that every player has a chance to get an opportunity to appear. He also considers Madura United an opponent that cannot be underestimated because they have good game organization and quality in the front line. 
 "I hope this will be a good match to watch," said Igor Tolic. Marc Klok, Thom Haye, and Mariano Peralta have the potential to be important parts of Persib's game. The ability to control the tempo and capitalize on opportunities will determine whether the visitors can overcome the pressure in Pamekasan. 
 Madura United and Persib Bandung Standings 
 Ahead of the match, Madura United occupies sixth place in the provisional standings with 10 points. Persib is right below them, in seventh position with the same number of points. 
 Both teams have identical records of three wins, one draw, and one loss. Madura United leads on goal difference. 
 With tight competition at the top, a win will be valuable for whoever manages to achieve it. 
 Persib has the opportunity to overtake Madura United if they win the match. Conversely, the hosts have the chance to widen the gap from Maung Bandung to three points. 
 Head to Head Madura United vs Persib 
 Looking at the results of previous meetings, Persib Bandung has a more convincing record. 
 In the last five meetings in the league competition, Persib recorded three wins and two draws without ever losing. 
 On February 26, 2026, Persib crushed Madura United with a score of 5-0 at the Gelora Bandung Lautan Api Stadium. 
 Previously, Maung Bandung also won 4-1 when visiting Pamekasan on November 30, 2025. 
 Two matches in 2024 and 2025 ended in draws, while the meeting on May 31, 2024, was won by Persib with a score of 3-1. 
 These records show Persib's historical advantage. However, Madura United's home performance this season means the match is not expected to be easy for the visitors. 
 Madura United vs Persib Bandung Prediction 
 In terms of squad quality and head-to-head records, Persib has the opportunity to bring home three points. The experience of facing an international schedule and the ability to control the game are advantages for Igor Tolic's team. 
 However, Madura United has several factors that could make things difficult for Persib, especially the support of the fans, their home record, and a relatively longer recovery time since their last match. 
 The midfield duel has the potential to determine the direction of the game. Persib needs to maintain ball possession so as not to give space to Madura United's offensive players to launch counterattacks. 
 On the other hand, the hosts must appear disciplined when losing the ball, especially when facing the movements of Persib players from the wings. 
 The match is expected to be open, with both teams having opportunities to score. 
 Madura United vs Persib Bandung score prediction: 1-2 for a Persib victory. 
 This prediction is an analysis before the match, not an official result. The possibility of a draw remains open if Madura United can maintain defensive solidity and maximize opportunities at home. 
 Where to Watch Madura United vs Persib? 
 National football fans can watch the match between Madura United and Persib Bandung through the live broadcast on Indosiar starting at 19:00 WIB. 
 In addition to television, the match is also scheduled to be available through the Vidio live streaming service. Viewers can check subscription packages and broadcast availability according to the platform's terms. 
 Broadcast schedules may change according to the policies of the competition organizers or broadcast rights holders. 
 With great motivation from both sides, the duel between Madura United and Persib Bandung is expected to be one of the matches to look forward to in the sixth week of the 2026/2027 Super League.
